name: pidp11-hacker-replicant
description: AI tutor/copilot chat panel for Oscar Vermeulen's PiDP-11 replica -- knows 2.11BSD, RT-11, RSX-11M+, RSTS/E and Unix v1-v7, and can optionally operate the machine's console. LLM-agnostic: works with any OpenAI-compatible backend (Ollama locally by default, or any hosted provider).
